title: Be someone’s favorite counselor.
intro: Bring your skills, your ridiculous camp spirit, and your care for kids. Help build the kind of queer community you wish you’d had growing up.

heroMedia.alt: Staff and campers sharing an unforgettable, high-energy moment.

theMagic.heading: You make a future visible.
theMagic.body: The way you move through the world matters here. As a queer grown-up at camp, you can become a role model simply by sharing the day: leading an activity, eating lunch, listening, and showing up again tomorrow.
bullets: Help kids try something they thought they couldn’t do.
Model care, curiosity, and respect in everyday moments.
Give campers someone to look up to who understands them.

theMud.heading: Great camp takes real work.
theMud.body: This is a job caring for kids. It asks for patience, sound judgment, teamwork, and energy, including on the hot, rainy, and tired days.
bullets: Share the daily responsibilities of bunk life and activities.
Help campers navigate homesickness, disagreements, and new experiences.
Take safety, boundaries, and camper care seriously.
Be ready to adapt, ask for help, and support your team.

theCommunity.heading: A team that gets you.
theCommunity.body: Our staff brings together queer counselors, activity leaders, and administrators. We share the work of building a camp where kids and adults can be themselves.
theCommunity.rolesOverview: Bring what you know, learn from the people around you, and help make a summer worth coming back to.

applicationProcess.heading: Let’s talk about this summer.
steps: Email Shira to ask about current openings and the application process.
Tell us about your experience, interests, and the kind of role you’re looking for.
Our team will share the next steps, including interviews and role requirements.
